stage.name: Fissure Strike
stage.description:
Condition: 

<Mudrock> and <Mudrock Colossus> HP swapped, and both have increased RES

<Manfred> 2nd form attacks an additional target, [Military Training] recovery rate greatly increased

<The Last Steam Knight> and <Scorching Steam Tank> are Invisible, and HP and ATK increased.

sarkaz_heirbearer_artificer.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Artificer
sarkaz_heirbearer_artificer.flavourText: An artificer of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed with the living blood of the Sanguinarch of Vampires. They gained a portion of Victoria's engineering expertise and are responsible for operating the reloading system of Londinium's city defense artillery.
abilities: Continuously charges up Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery; when interrupted, the Defense Artillery will lose a portion of its charge progress
Will be reborn as a <Touch of the Sanguinarch> after falling in battle for the first time

seed_of_withering.name: Seed of Withering
seed_of_withering.flavourText: Originium Arts creation of the Nachzehrer King. Mindless except for an obsession with self-destruction. They create death for others to feed upon.
abilities: Flying unit.
Self-destructs when near an Operator, dealing Physical damage

leithanian_rebel_leader.name: Leithanian Rebel Leader
leithanian_rebel_leader.flavourText: One of Leithanien's local militia leaders. The widespread popularity of classical Originium Arts has made them more threatening, and their attacks inflict Arts damage.

gift_of_the_sanguinarch.name: Gift of the Sanguinarch
gift_of_the_sanguinarch.flavourText: A creation of the Sanguinarch of Vampires' Originium Arts that bears greater vitality. One who was powerful in life will continue to be a great threat to their enemies even after being reshaped by the power of the Sanguinarch's blessing.
abilities: Reborn Creation (takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage)
Units blocking it gain +1 Block (up to a maximum of +6)

touch_of_the_sanguinarch.name: Touch of the Sanguinarch
touch_of_the_sanguinarch.flavourText: A creation of the Sanguinarch of Vampires' Originium Arts, flexible and difficult to defeat. According to rumors, the Sanguinarch is able to snatch the blood of other creatures, imbuing new life into it and taking it under his control.
abilities: Reborn Creation (takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage)
Units blocking it gain +1 Block (up to a maximum of +6)

scorching_steam_tank.name: Scorching Steam Tank
scorching_steam_tank.flavourText: Advanced armored vehicle employing Victorian steam technology, even more dangerous when it has taken damage. Virtually unstoppable when it is on a rampage.
abilities: When HP drops to 50%, ASPD and Movement Speed are greatly increased, and becomes immune to most control effects.

sarkaz_heirbearer_asv.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer ASV
sarkaz_heirbearer_asv.flavourText: An armored supply vehicle blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires. While on the battlefield, enhances Gift of the Sanguinarch and Touch of the Sanguinarch.
abilities: While in battle, Reborn Creations have increased ATK, and their attacks will additionally deal Necrosis

mudrock_matterllurgist_leader.name: Mudrock Matterllurgist Leader
mudrock_matterllurgist_leader.flavourText: A member of Mudrock's Sarkaz squad. Integrating Sarkaz tactics with Leithanian Arts to greater effect, they are capable of inflicting lethal damage with a block of energy, and prioritize attacking units closest to the contract entrance site.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking units that are vying for control of a 'Gramophone.'
Attacks 2 targets simultaneously

sarkaz_heirbearer_hatedrinker.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Hatedrinker
sarkaz_heirbearer_hatedrinker.flavourText: A soldier of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires. The hatred of their compatriots slain on the battlefield builds up within them, making them more than eager to tear apart the enemies of the Sarkaz.
abilities: Gains increased ATK for each Reborn Creation on the battlefield
Will be reborn as a <Gift of the Sanguinarch> after falling in battle for the first time

sarkaz_heirbearer_chain_caster.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Chain Caster
sarkaz_heirbearer_chain_caster.flavourText: A caster of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires. Trained by the Royal Court, they pose a wide-ranging threat on the battlefield with their Arts.
abilities: Attacks deal Necrosis and jump between 4 targets, with each jump dealing reduced damage
Will be reborn as a <Gift of the Sanguinarch> after falling in battle for the first time

mudrock_colossus.name: Mudrock Colossus
mudrock_colossus.flavourText: This Originium construct, crafted by Mudrock, does not possess sentience and must be directly controlled by Mudrock. Though bulky and slow, they are extremely durable and boast terrifying physical damage and survivability.

winterwisp_blood_magister.name: Winterwisp Blood Magister
winterwisp_blood_magister.flavourText: A mixed-blood well-versed in Winterwisp's ancient Blood Arts, much more terrifying than modern Casters. Their ancient sacrificial rituals are capable of instantly dealing area Arts damage, as well as severing Arts ley lines to seize control of L-44 'Gramophones.'
abilities: Will gradually lose HP over time
Upon death, deals a large amount of Arts damage to all surrounding units and immediately seizes control of any 'Gramophones'

the_last_steam_knight.name: 'The Last Steam Knight'
the_last_steam_knight.flavourText: Steam Knights are the pride of Victoria, her fist, her highest military honor. The last Steam Knight rises from sealed ruins, intent on defending the Victoria in his heart.
abilities: Debut Phase
ATK and Movement Speed are reduced, but restored once [Pneumatic Pressurization] is triggered
First Form
[Pneumatic Pressurization] Gains increased ATK and Movement Speed and becomes immune to control effects; stuns self when effect expires
[Furious Defense] Charges up before attacking, dealing heavy damage 3 times

[Unto My Last Breath] Leaps into the air after losing a certain amount of HP, targeting your unit with highest max HP and dealing multiple Arts damage hits to the nearby unit with the highest HP percentage
Second Form
Has reduced DEF and RES
[Pneumatic Pressurization] becomes permanently active
[Unto My Last Breath] locks onto an additional target

manfred.name: Manfred
manfred.flavourText: A young Sarkaz general, member of the Military Commission of Kazdel. After enlisting a large number of mercenaries in Londinium, he has assembled and trained a brand new type of fighting force. His Arts Unit 'Teekazwurtzen' was bestowed upon him by Theresis, the Regent of Kazdel, who also taught him the swordsmanship he now employs.
abilities: Deals Arts damage with his floating cannon, attacks charge up Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery
[Military Training] Has high Physical and Arts dodge, but after being bombarded by the Defense Artillery, temporarily loses this dodge effect and is stunned for a period of time
First Form
[Focus] Continuously gains ASPD when attacking the same target (this effect is capped), resets when switching targets or not attacking for a few seconds
Second Form

[From Withered Trunk, New Branches] When defeated for the first time, randomly attacks all targets on the battlefield with his floating cannon, greatly accelerating the charge rate of Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery
In his second form, draws his sword alongside his floating cannon to perform simultaneous Physical and Arts attacks

mudrock.name: Mudrock
mudrock.flavourText: Age unknown, gender unknown, history unknown. This ex-Reunion member now leads an organization of Infected and wanders the wilderness between the cities of Leithanien. What thoughts run through Mudrock's mind as being forced to once again step upon the battlefield?
abilities: Every attack permanently increases ATK, stacking up to 6 times
Has a Barrier that absorbs Arts damage; while the Barrier persists, this unit has significantly increased Max HP and ASPD.
Barrier periodically refreshes.
Can use a skill to automatically seize control of the nearest non-enemy controlled 'Gramophone'
